name: Collapsible
summary: A single show-and-hide section with a chevron before its label, built on a native details element.
description: Use it for optional detail next to a form or a paragraph: advanced options, a reason we ask, extra help. For a list of several related sections, use an accordion.

classes.name: v-collapsible
classes.description: On the <details> itself. The chevron points at the inline end and turns down when open.

states.description: The section is open and the chevron points down.

a11y: The <summary> is announced as a button with its expanded state, with no ARIA added.
The chevron flips in right-to-left text so it still points the way the text reads.
Write the summary as what opens ("Show advanced options"), not a bare "More".
